module_summary: include/launchelf.h is the umbrella header of the EE program: SDK includes, version/debug macros, the SETTING config struct (about 27.5 KB, one heap copy), FILEINFO, size limits (MAX_PATH 1025, MAX_ENTRY 2048, MAX_PATH_PAD 30), and prototypes for main/init/elf/draw/pad/config/filer/editor/lang. editor_private.h, filer_shared.h and filer_internal.h are the private interfaces of the classic text editor and file browser (globals, menu enums, copy/paste modes, MAX_RECURSE). ftp_protocol.h, nfsman.h, smb2man.h, smbd_devctl.h, pccf_control.h and wle_igr_config.h are fixed-layout EE/IOP or EE/IGR ABIs (RPC status packet, devctl codes and argument structs); psu_types.h holds the PSU/memory-card header layouts; cloud_google.h is the Google Drive backup API. loader/loader.c plus loader/linkfile form the small embedded loader ELF (linked at 0x84000-0xa0000) that clears user RAM, optionally idles/powers down DEV9 and resets the IOP, then runs a file ELF via SifLoadElf or a mem:ADDR:SIZE payload. src/chkesr.c is the upstream ESR-disc probe (reads DVD LBA 14 and looks for +NSR). include/snippets/readCD.h is the legacy-libcdvd readCD(), only compiled under LIBCDVD_LEGACY.

reusable_helpers.name: wle_stricmp
reusable_helpers.what: ASCII case-insensitive string compare (static inline), mapped to stricmp

reusable_helpers.name: wle_strnlen
reusable_helpers.what: NULL-safe bounded strlen (static inline), mapped to strnlen

reusable_helpers.name: listCenteredTop
reusable_helpers.what: computes the first visible row of a scrolled list keeping the selection near the upper middle, clamped at both ends

reusable_helpers.name: parseHex8
reusable_helpers.what: parses exactly 8 hex digits into a u32

reusable_helpers.name: loadELFImage
reusable_helpers.what: validates an in-memory ELF header and copies/zero-fills its PT_LOAD segments, then flushes caches

reusable_helpers.name: clearUserMem
reusable_helpers.what: zeroes EE user RAM from 0x100000 to GetMemorySize() with 128-bit stores

reusable_helpers.name: Check_ESR_Disc
reusable_helpers.what: detects an ESR-patched DVD by reading LBA 14 and checking for +NSR
